mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FARM(FARMER_EMAIL, FARM_NAME, FARM_ADDR, FARM_DESC, FARM_IMG) VALUES(#{farmerEmail},#{farmName},#{farmAddr},#{farmDesc}, #{farmImg} )
mapper.select: SELECT FARM_ID ,FARMER_EMAIL ,FARM_NAME ,FARM_ADDR ,FARM_DESC ,FARM_IMG ,CREATED_DATE FROM FARM ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC

SELECT F.FARM_ID, F.FARMER_EMAIL, F.FARM_NAME, F.FARM_ADDR, F.FARM_DESC, F.FARM_IMG, M.MEM_NAME, M.MEM_NICKNAME, M.MEM_TEL, M.MEM_PROFILE_IMG FROM FARM F JOIN MEM_INFO M ON F.FARMER_EMAIL = M.MEM_EMAIL WHERE F.FARM_ID = #{farmId}
SELECT FARM_ID, FARMER_EMAIL, FARM_NAME, FARM_ADDR, FARM_DESC, FARM_IMG, CREATED_DATE FROM FARM WHERE FARMER_EMAIL = #{farmerEmail} ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC
